task: Take the BOX_MIDDLE of the box and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. After that, the stack should look like it is removed the middle box ONLY. NOTE: only the top box of the box stack can be picked(like the data structure).
plan_summary: The robot CAR will navigate to the box stack, pick the top box (BOX_TOP) first, place it temporarily on TEMP_TABLE, then go back to pick the newly exposed BOX_MIDDLE, place it on INSPECTION_TABLE, and finally retrieve BOX_TOP from TEMP_TABLE and place it back on the original stack location (on BOX_BOTTOM) to restore the stack without the middle box.
assumptions: BOX_TOP is the top of the stack and can be picked first.
TEMP_TABLE and INSPECTION_TABLE are within interaction distance after navigating.
The coordinates of the original stack location for BOX_TOP placement are the same as BOX_BOTTOM's location.
The robot can hold only one object at a time.
